sources: https://secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog (Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog, read 2026-11-20 via its public getTabs/getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON): tab 'Alcova Reservoir': 'Alcova Reservoir offers both first come first served campgrounds as well as reservation only campgrounds'; 'Restroom facilities are provided at each Alcova Reservoir Campground.'; group 'Fremont (First Come, First Served)': 'First Come, First Served. $15.00 a night. Fremont Canyon Campground is at the southern end of Lakeshore Drive located at the mouth of the canyon area. Campground information and pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside of each Natrona County Park. An ADA accessible site is available. This campground also provides a boat ramp and each site has a fire ring and picnic table.'; facility 'Fremont Non-Reservable Sites' Nightly Rate base fee $13.39 (the $15 is with tax); the group's Google Maps link resolves to 'Fremont Canyon Campground' at 42.5197751,-106.7757962

Rec1 catalog page Terms & Conditions (read 2026-11-20): 'Each camping unit or individual is permitted to camp for a maximum of ten (10) days in any one campground. Upon the tenth (10) day, the camping unit must be removed or moved to a different campground other than the original campground.'; 'All camping permits start at 3:00 pm on the first day of the permit period and expire at 11:00 am on the last day of the permit period.'; 'Call Parks Department office at 307-235-9325'
https://www.natronacounty-wy.gov/225/Fremont-Canyon-Campground and the site map DocumentCenter/View/6449 - known bot-refusing domain (403); not fetched this pass

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (400 m and two 150 m half-width crops): the camp is the juniper-dotted flat between the county road and the west shore, ~450 m north to south, from the private marina/trailer park at the north end to the boat ramp at the canyon mouth; dirt spurs with a few small shelters ~30 m back from the shore; two trailers parked on the open shore flat ~10-15 m from the water (about 42.5172,-106.7731 and 42.5163,-106.7728); a dock beside them; stored pin 42.51831,-106.77462 is beside the road in the middle of the camp, 190 m from the county's Google point

values.note: Each site has a fire ring and picnic table; one ADA site.

sites.source: Rec1 group 'Fremont (First Come, First Served)' ('An ADA accessible site is available ... each site has a fire ring and picnic table'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Pay at the roadside kiosk pay boxes. Permits run 3 pm to 11 am; after 10 days a camping unit must move to a different campground.

booking.source: Rec1 group 'Fremont (First Come, First Served)' ('First Come, First Served'; 'pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside') + catalog Terms & Conditions (10-day limit in any one campground, permits 3:00 pm to 11:00 am), read 2026-11-20

fees.source: Rec1 group 'Fremont (First Come, First Served)' ('$15.00 a night'; facility nightly rate $13.39 before tax), read 2026-11-20

note: Natrona County primitive campground at the mouth of Fremont Canyon, south end of Alcova Reservoir, with a boat ramp and restrooms; sites look over the lake and the canyon. No drinking water. --Claude
